# MrGrammar

> MrGrammar is a free, open source Chrome extension that fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation in any text box without changing the writer's tone, word choice or sentence structure. Select text, right-click and choose "Fix Grammar with AI" (or press Ctrl+Shift+E, Cmd+Shift+E on Mac), and the corrected text replaces the selection in place.

Key facts:
- Price: free, no account, no API key, no credit card.
- Works in: Gmail, Outlook on the web, Slack, LinkedIn messages and comments, Facebook, Messenger, and most ordinary text boxes. Runs in Chrome, Edge, Brave and other Chromium browsers. Google Docs is not supported.
- What it changes: spelling, grammar and punctuation only. It does not rewrite sentences or change tone.
- Privacy: text leaves the browser only when the user asks for a correction and is never stored. No accounts, cookies or analytics. Corrections are produced by Google Gemini with Groq as a backup.
- Limits: 10 corrections a minute and 200 a day per person, selections up to 10,000 characters.
- Rating: 5.0 out of 5 from 8 ratings on the Chrome Web Store (October 2026).
- Made by Saleep Shrestha. MIT licensed.
